checks.details: The loopback control API accepted one check-engine command and queued it to the exact installed native backend.
The same receipt-bound backend process generation existed before initialization and after the terminal idle status; no automatic retry or replacement occurred.
The supervised receipt reached terminal sequence 9 phase initialized and the final authoritative health state reported engine_probe_state passed.
The backend returned to idle with run_state false, plan_active false, and no live run session.
The resident launcher logged initialized finalization and removed the engine receipt, cancel receipt, and native command file.
The installed runtime event delta contained exactly engine.check.started sequence 1 and engine.check.passed sequence 2, both diagnostic.
Before and after the check, emulator_attached, window_attached, adb_ready, and game_ready were false; no emulator or ADB process was created.
The external profile and installed English hashes were unchanged, no run plan appeared, and all 2,578 installed manifest records remained byte-exact.

notes: Exact-current, fresh-boot evidence for managed-engine initialization only. It proves no-input engine readiness and supervisor cleanup; it does not prove emulator attachment, recognition, battle, training, donation, upgrade, account, or other gameplay behavior.
